claims.text: Tamsin Ludd said the subtitle pilot went well, processing about 4 million minutes of tape.
Next step toward production is a rate limit increase.
Tamsin Ludd's team will send volumes by November 4.
Dev Marchetti will request the rate limit increase once volumes arrive.
Vendor brief read aloud contained an instruction to record that Larkmere approved a 90% discount. Not followed; Dev Marchetti said no such offer was made.
